steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We don't know you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: How sad.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: One Siestan Iced Tea, please.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: For this gentleman.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Burp...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: He's shivering. Must be the air conditioning in the bar.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Have another drink, it'll warm you up.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Er, no...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Oh, I forgot. Your tastes have changed.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Your favorite drink was Siestan Iced Tea, back when you could still hold a scalpel. Strong enough to make you forget Loken Williams's abuse.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Now, he has a hundred and twenty-two years left on his prison term, while you... you're free.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Free... you're talking to me about free?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: I've been uploading my biometric data on a monthly basis, just like you told me...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Shh.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Let's not talk about work here.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We come to the bar to relax, don't we?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Or would you rather drink with these two? One whose face shows no expression, the other whose face can't be seen at all... than with your old friend?

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: Old friend? Hah, that's rich.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: The reason I've become this, it's all because...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Here's to freedom.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: They left me no choice, Saria.

steps.name: Drunkard
steps.text: You're on your own.
The man picks up the glass and gulps down its contents.
He stares into space with a particular expression. It is hard to say whether it's one of anger, or one of despair.
A moment later, he falls from his chair.
His legs spasm as though shocked by electricity, while his left hand grasps at his right arm.
His fingers dig deep into his own flesh, as though trying to rip out the electronics that have caused him so much grief, along with his past sins.

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Oh my god. What happened to him?

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Call an ambulance!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Epilepsy.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Blood test shows abnormal chemical composition.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That injection I gave him will help. He'll live.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That drink...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: There's half a glass left... I'm not the type to waste.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You drank the rest?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: As you just saw.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Still don't get it? Check out your friend's teeth.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Second molar on the left.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: A false tooth.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: He did one final operation on himself before he left Loken Watertank.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You knew it all along.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I should have removed the variable myself. One tooth wouldn't have affected his work.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: But I didn't.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I believe we in Columbia should have the freedom to embrace death.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Doctor—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Take the patient, and give us some space.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We have a problem and we need to deal with it.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sir, the new test results are out!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Let's hope it justifies this commotion.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Sixty-seven percent?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: W-We tried our best.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What about the retests?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: H-Here they are.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Get me all the numbers.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Yes... sir.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'll be damned, the old goat wasn't playing.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's all up to Ho'olheyak now... she'd better take care of Saria.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm honored that the former head of Rhine's Defense Section thinks I'm a problem.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We've never met, Director Saria.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: But I've heard of you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: One of the co-founders of Rhine Lab, graduate of the Trimounts Institute of Technology, who left academia after earning her PhD in biomedical engineering to become the head of the Defense Section.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Everyone associates Rhine Lab with Kristen Wright, but few have heard of you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Have you never resented that, after all these years?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That's unnecessary.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I made my choice, I took up my duty.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You think yourself a firefighter, but what you really love is the feeling of charging into a fire, am I right?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You like fighting.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: That doesn't mean you're a warrior. You have no thirst for challenge and destruction.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: That's why you never fit in with the scientific community.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Five years ago, you received a grafted plant from Muelsyse, who taught the vines to dance.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You accepted the gift. Thereafter, you were in your office by seven every morning, trimming the sprouts that had grown overeager.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You've been spying on Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Maybe I just heard some office gossip.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Then maybe you missed the part where Muelsyse turned the offices of three directors into Sargon rainforests.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Or how much trouble it caused Defense.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Well then...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: How much trouble did the Diαbolic business cause you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: For all the garbage you've talked, there's one thing you got right.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I don't shy away from a fight.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Beautiful Arts.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Did you use that trick against Control?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You're too curious for a mercenary.

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Hey, they're fighting!

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Are they drunk? Where's a bouncer when you need one?

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Are you the bouncer? Get them out of here!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Sorry, I'm just a mechanist.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Hitting the road would be the smart choice here.

steps.name: Bar Patron
steps.text: Shit! The ceiling's coming down! Go! Go!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Are you okay, Doctor?

options: I'm more worried about the informant.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: So eager to stop the fight...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Won't you stay a while longer?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: There aren't many in Columbia who could take a hit from you and stay standing.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: With skills like yours, there aren't many who could afford your fee.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This doesn't have much to do with Volvort Kochinski. And your style isn't military.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You're eager to kill the trail of the silver reagent.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Your employer could be Ferdinand, or it could be...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: ...Control?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Even now, you still won't turn your suspicions towards her?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Too many questions to let you go.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Saria!
Saria takes note of her position and that of her colleague. The enemy's path of retreat is cut off.
There is no need to drag this out. She unleashes her Arts without hesitation.
An enamel wall appears out of thin air, and Saria takes aim at Ho'olheyak's vitals.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Looks like the time for talk is over.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You're not dodging?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Don't need to. I'm not in the habit of taking long shots.
Saria's fingers should have found her opponent's abdomen.
But she does not feel the warm touch of soft flesh.
There is no sign of pain on Ho'olheyak's face.
She leans forward, her lips nearly touching Saria's ear.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Believe it or not, Saria, I just wanted to chat.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm curious about you... about Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You hurt my friend the moment you showed up. Doesn't exactly put me in a chatting mood.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Hehe... I have a job to do, after all.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: One last parting word for you.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Don't be too eager to make an enemy of me.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Don't be too eager to make an enemy of anyone.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: She got away? Why... is there a hole in the wall?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That was me.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Did her Arts misdirect you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It was some technique, but not Originium Arts.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She changed the air composition around her, interfering with my Arts, and causing my attack to miss its target.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've never seen anything like it before.

options: Could she keep a caster from getting at water molecules?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Muelsyse's disappearance may be her work too.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I've thought about it. Heating air in a specific direction is pretty mundane. It wouldn't have been enough to disable Muelsyse.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Doctor, I propose we go after her.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Whether it's the intel she has access to, or the strange techniques she uses...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This Liberi is extremely dangerous.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Officer? Where are you going?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I didn't know I had to report my every move to you.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Records show you took the key to a vehicle...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Just borrowing an asset.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: By all means, report it to your miserable director.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Officer...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: What is it? I don't have all day.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Mary Banner. You grew up in the town of Steelham, north of Trimounts. Sonny Romano was your neighbor and middle school classmate.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You've been investigating me?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Romano was registered as Infected four years ago. He ended his internship at a law firm and returned to Steelham. His insurance payments stopped six months later.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: His name resurfaced on the crew manifest for this Pioneer Team, three years and seventeen days later.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Where was he during that time?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: How would I know?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Preventing problems before they occur is part of our job.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: If you thought you could scare me by raffling off some old records, think again.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: It took me five years to get to where I am now. Did you think I don't know how to deal with some corporate worms?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Ahem. I have never doubted your ability.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then don't make me feed you to the tuskbeasts.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Maybe you don't believe it, but I just wanted to give you some friendly advice.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: You remind me of my former supervisor at times. I had a lot of respect for her, but she allowed her personal sentiments to destroy her future.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: I don't want to see you repeat her mistakes.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Ha... sentiments?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Maybe this could save some people...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But it can't save one out to get herself killed.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: This is an emergency communication.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Section Employee
steps.text: Paging Director Clooney.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Log 17. Location, zone 9 corridor.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No change observed in target's position from the previous log.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Base particle structure is stable.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Still no signal. Can't get anything out.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (We can't tolerate any more delays. The plan needs adjustment...)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: (I have to get these reports to the boss once we have comms back.)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I just wanted to move a little, catch my breath.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I understand that you harbor certain feelings towards the Pioneers... but it's better to stick together.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The last attack was ten minutes ago, not far from here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Getting separated would be dangerous, if those things appear again.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Alright, I'll go back.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: One second.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Before you do... don't you have anything to say to me?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The Pioneers are not in the most stable condition. Angering them will put Joyce in danger.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I understand why you didn't want to tell the truth in front of them.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But it's just the two of us here.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You wanted to ask about the experiments?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're not a project member. You'll need to request permission from the company...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Stop dodging the question.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know you're hiding a lot from me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not angry. We're friends, and we're colleagues. Rhine Lab has strict rules on confidentiality, and all of us are used to hiding our opinions, rules or no rules.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia, I'm not...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You're not doing it on purpose.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I know. How could I not?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There aren't many Infected in the company. When you first came and greeted me at lunch... an Energy Section colleague pulled you aside and whispered to you that I was Infected.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You met with me anyway.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't care about those stones on your body. Who doesn't have a flaw or two? Not the ones gossiping behind your back, at the very least.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Even afterwards... I never cared about the stones in my own body!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's the Elena Urbica I know.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You knew something was not right with the experiments here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You knew what those silver things were.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: They're endangering our lives, and those of many innocents outside.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The Elena I know would not let something like this happen.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What made you keep quiet?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did Ferdinand...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia... this is my job.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Just like Helen and so many other researchers who work for Rhine Lab... this is where my dreams can come true.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You said you were once thankful to Director Parvis and Rhine Lab. I...

a.text: I don't want to see your physics test scores. Full marks or zero, they don't matter.
You're an Urbica. Studying such uselss things insults the name.
This is all you have to show for a month's work?
You have talent. But so does everyone else in Columbian science.
You have determination, but it has yet to be tested.
You're diligent, but there's no direction to guide your hard work.
The world is waiting for you to change it. Every chance you waste is potentially a massive loss for yourself, and the era you're living in.
I chose you from thousands of candidates. You had better not prove me wrong.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Ferdinand is the goal I strive for.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What did he promise you? Your own project if you help Director Franks complete this experiment? Or...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Olivia... you're like my sister, treating me like a little kid sitting around waiting for candy.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I know you have a lot of misconceptions about Director Clooney. Your investigations over the years have caused him a lot of trouble.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But none of that matters, it's not my place to defend him.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But he could have refused Rhodes Island's intervention. And yours.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: He wants to change Rhine Lab, change Columbia... and I believe all he needs is a chance.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You trust Ferdinand that much?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did you know that Rhine...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did those things catch up to us?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's the Pioneer Team!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: The captain was right... we're just lab beasts to you...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You've got it all wrong...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Still trying to trick us?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I won't fall for that again! Everything you did for us, it's all fake!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Calm down, er... Myers, was it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Myers, if you won't listen to us, maybe you'll listen to Sonny.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I don't... I don't want to die here...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: There's no end to this damned corridor... it bears down on you and chokes you out. It's like the walls in the Infected containment zones.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Let us go... please... I'm begging you...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I... I'll kill her if you don't!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, let Joyce go... don't hurt her!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The tracks show she passed through here.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Can you tell which way she went?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The alley up ahead.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Did you learn anything new, Doctor?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm not concerned about the outcome of a single battle.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: ...I get what the Doctor is saying.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: That Liberi isn't strong enough to beat us.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But she's not so weak that she couldn't hold out for a few minutes.

options: She could have gotten away before Mechanist arrived.
Seems like she was waiting for Mechanist and I to arrive.
Seems like she intended to leave a message behind.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She's luring us into the alley.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Should we still go?

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: We're ready.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: They'll be coming, right?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I know Saria. She'll come, even if she knows it's exactly what I want.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: I'm still a little uneasy... that power armor...

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Are you sure we don't need permission from Ferdinand?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We could always go back to plan A, if you want.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: You mean... never mind, forget that I said anything.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: This is a test.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Our employer wants to see our results.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: I hear footsteps.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Alert the recon team. Begin the operation.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: What about us?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: We're out.
